$comment: Origem dos logos sem SVG vetorial: a URL antiga só serve raster (ou 404). O raster não fica no repositório; o azulejo é provisório até haver manual/<slug>.svg ou source/<slug>.svg vetorial.

federal-bank.notes: Official current (2025) wordmark from federalbank.co.in: blue wordmark + orange bar on white. The app icon shows a new 'F' symbol for which no vector was found (the official logo-kit zip is behind a bot check).

karur-vysya-bank.notes: Official white KVB mark from kvb.bank.in on the site's brand green #16643B. Note: the app icon uses the older yellow/green emblem.

actinver.notes: Wikimedia Commons wordmark. Tile: full wordmark in white with the gold dot on Actinver navy #041E41 (app icon uses navy). The app icon shows only 'A' + dot; no separate vector of that lockup was found, so the full wordmark is used.

albo.notes: Wikimedia Commons wordmark; tile uses only its 'a' glyph (#4052B6) on white, matching the albo app icon.

banbajio.notes: Wikimedia Commons (via Brands of the World). Tile: the BB symbol in its source red #BF0411 on white (app icon: red BB on white; app red looks brighter, ~#FE0000).

banco-azteca.notes: Wikimedia Commons. Tile: green/red symbol on white; colors match the current app icon.

bancoppel.notes: Grupo Coppel 2025 symbol (three circles, #F0D224) from Wikimedia Commons; the BanCoppel app icon uses this same symbol in yellow on navy. Navy #001F6F sampled from the official app icon (no vector source for the background color).

bankaool.notes: Inline <svg> wordmark in the header of bankaool.com (fill currentColor rendered black). Tile: black wordmark on white, like the app icon.

banorte.notes: Wikimedia Commons symbol (#EC1C2D). Tile: white symbol on Banorte red, like the app icon. banorte.com blocks automated fetches.

banregio.notes: Official logo served by banregio.com (orange #FF6B00 tile + white wordmark). The current app icon shows a newer 'smile' symbol for which no vector was found.

cibanco.notes: Wikimedia Commons. Tile: the tri-colour swoosh symbol on white.

citibanamex.notes: Official current Banamex logo from banamex.com (post Citi separation). Tile: the flower symbol #FF1B44 on the wordmark teal #003746, matching the app icon.

inbursa.notes: Official logo from inbursa.com. Tile: navy #0A1D3F symbol on white (the app icon is blue with an inverted symbol whose geometry is not in any vector source).

intercam.notes: Wikimedia Commons. Tile: globe symbol on white.

klar.notes: Official wordmark from klar.mx (white), recoloured black on white as in the app icon.

multiva.notes: Official 'm' icon from multiva.com.mx; background #FF4813 from the official logo https://www.multiva.com.mx/documents/d/guest/logov3.

sabadell.notes: Official isologo from bancosabadell.mx. Tile: the B of the blue circle (circle minus disc, exact geometry) in white on #006DFF, like the app icon.

stori.notes: Official logo from storicard.com; tile uses the symbol (#003A40) on #00D080 sampled from the official app icon.

arvest.notes: Wikimedia Commons wordmark (#00264F). Tile: white wordmark on the wordmark navy, as on arvest.com header and the app icon.

everbank.notes: Official logo served by everbank.com. Tile: symbol in white on the symbol blue #1751E7, like the app icon.

simmons-bank.notes: Wikimedia Commons. Tile: the black/red symbol (cropped from the lockup) on white, as in the app icon. simmonsbank.com only serves PNG.

wafd-bank.notes: Official logo from wafdbank.com. Tile: green symbol #009639 on white, like the app icon.

nainital-bank.notes: English Wikipedia (non-free) SVG of the seal; its 9 embedded raster <image> overlays were removed (the vector paths alone render the full seal), strokes outlined. Matches the seal on nainitalbank.bank.in.
